analysis:
Only head-text excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (lines 235-598) were supplied. No patch hunks, so added lines cannot be separated from existing ones. The file is documentation, so there is no direct runtime security regression, and no concrete finding is reportable from these excerpts. Entries relevant to the threat model that later passes should check against the code and threat-model files:
- Frozen legacy MDM cohort (CHANGELOG.md:252-263), against TB-009 and TB-011 and T-036/T-052/T-057. The entries are consistent with the TB-009 limitation text: generic profiles stay copyable, /v1/enroll needs a linked provider token plus an SE-key proof, noncohort routes require App Attest, and base rewards need macOS 27 plus qualified App Attest. Check that enrollment.go, policy.go and the economics code match.
- App Attest protocol 3 only and the provider-version floor excluding unversioned providers (CHANGELOG.md:522, 528-530). Raising the floor in the live env is a human step. Also: attestation challenges fail closed without status_signature (T-036/T-037).
- Removal of unauthenticated GET /v1/provider/earnings?wallet= (CHANGELOG.md:526, T-031) and of /v1/telemetry/events.
- SSD prefix-cache TTL raised from 15 to 30 minutes, and the default write budget raised from 150 to 750 GB/day (CHANGELOG.md:467-469, 551). This is a possible T-041/SEC-035 update. The entry says the re-acceptance is recorded in the threat model, and it is not visible here whether the PR adds that.
- Cache routing persistence (CHANGELOG.md:426-432): no prompts or raw chain hashes persisted; check T-041.
- Cached prompt pricing, bounded non-streaming responses, the OpenRouter-based advisory review workflow and its secret/budget handling (CHANGELOG.md:285-291, 462-465). Also the bank payout migration (CHANGELOG.md:292-296, TB-008/T-030).
Coverage limit: no source code was provided, so none of these claims were verified.
